text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The racetrack erupted over Hokko Tarumae's 
victory! Though Smart Falcon cannot run 
alongside her, she expects the upcoming 
Tokyo Daishoten to be truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through her run, Hokko Tarumae showed 
Copano Rickey what it truly meant to be on 
the front lines of dirt racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was something she had learned from 
Wonder Acute last year. Wonder Acute 
murmured thoughtfully about how feelings 
are passed on like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the year's final showdown, the 
Tokyo Daishoten, was right around the 
corner...!
